g.text: so i have a question but it's attached to a story first so strap in
so i was taking some notes on some code i was working on on some pieces of paper on my desk right
and quincy came over and took the pieces of paper and used them for target practice because he "didn't see anything important on them"
w h a t t h e a c t u a l
then he laughed at me when i was upset
this is why i like machines more than people
but you don't count, you spend most of your time INSIDE machines
um. shit. i forgot my question. gimmie a hot second
I'm fine, thanks for asking. How're you?
oh yeah oops hiiiii sorry how're you i'm upset thanks

you said some of the cephalons are your besties, yeah?
do you have any friendships with the celphalons?
Kind of. Cephalons aren't exactly "computers" but they're close enough for what you're thinking.
They help out on Deimos & where they can.
They try their best, and they care deeply.
He helps pilot my railjack - one of my space ships.
He's a good friend. Helps pilot my railjack, one of my spaceships.
Digital glass brains, kind of. A person that was stripped of their body and reprogrammed.
He watches over the ship, keeps an eye on things.
It was an execution method and a fate worse than death, but they're a person preserved as a sort of computer.
oh right you said his name once before
why're you putting them together like that?

HOW MANY SPACE SHIPS DO YOU OWN?!

Two, but I also have an archwing I can use to get around in space.
yeah but that's just code that can be fixed
like a goddamn millionaire "just my two yachts"

feelings and immortality and no pesky body AND FREE WILL if it hasn't been overwritten?!?!?!
